{| width="100%" | valign="top" | '''QuakeWorld summary for [[Image:flag_pt.gif]] {{PAGENAME}}''' Once very active, the [https://discord.gg/EN6VP3e Portuguese community] has historically been turned to itself.
Players rarely played outside local servers until 1999, when lower latency technologies like ISDN and Cable were publicaly available.
In the post-[[Smackdown]] era (from 2003), there was much less players than before, but they all played in Europe, especially on UK/NL/GER servers, with pings between 50ms and 90ms. The main issue about the Portuguese community was that was often 'split'.
There are/were many players from Madeira Island. They had their own servers and continental Portugal as well.
Pings between them were not so good, minimum 40ms.
Madeira players had good 13ms ping on their servers (all players had cable connections after 1999) but bad to continental Portugal (~60ms). There was rivality between these two communities, that almost vanished in 2007.
While some players never stoped playing, some make occasional returns, and many still follow the main events from a distance. * [[:Category:Portuguese Players|Portuguese Players]] * [[:Category:Portuguese Clans|Portuguese Clans]] | width="20" | | valign="top" align="right" width="150" | __TOC__ |} == Famous players == * [[Mushi]] * [[Hammer]] * [[Nitemare]] * [[Lake]] aka [[orc]] * [[Norules]] * [[Ztranger]] * [[Trouble]] * [[Seablade]] * [[Boggs]] * [[DarkMaster]] * [[Yurgen]] * [[Giggs]] * [[Hectic]] * [[Commander_ZOD]] * [[Apulax]] aka [[Zip]] * [[Dread]] == Famous clans == * Brotherhood of Blood - |B| * Rest In Pieces - RIP * ]Z[ * [[Quinas]] * [[Rebellion of Thunder]] - [[ROT]] * [[DEFS]] == History == It started in [[1996]]. 14.4kbs and 28.8 modems were the only internet connections available. Pings > 200 and plenty of players.
Every night the Telepac servers were full. 10-20 players in ffa server and 20-30 in the 3 TF servers. Dozens of clans.
Many activity in the main IRC server in Portugal, PTNET. #quake was ruled by a bot named Frag. He decided when to kick a user. Frag had good memory also: he saved the funniest quotes ever.
To get a clanwar going, it was needed a admin (thx DarthVader) with rcon (no [[Kombat Teams]] back then) to restart the map when everyone was ready.
Some ppl with slow computers tooked alot longer than others to join. ahh.. :) Playing [[4on4]] with ping 250 on [[dm6]] dmm3 was fun.
Regarding duels, some played dmm1 20min, some dmm3 20min... We had our own rules.
There was no easy way to change server settings.
[[CTF]] was quite common also, especially on LANs (see below).
When Quake 2 was released few moved... the scene was still quite large with a dozen clans playing in our Leagues. It was usual these leagues never ending: the better, rival clans were 'afraid' to play each other, oh the pride... ===1999=== In [[1999]], Quake 3 and Unreal Tournament did a severe cut into QuakeWorld.
Many players left to play newer games. Some came back, some didn't.
ISDN arrived. Cable soon followed. Much better pings (30-100ms) ===2002=== From [[2002]] on, all those clans resumed to 2/4 active clans, and more players leaving the game and resume their lives.
Broadband is common. 13-50ms in local servers. ADSL. ===2007=== In [[2007]], some are still here, playing, with wife's, kids, etc.
It's different, no local servers, best ping is 50ms on UK servers. Much less activity but the spirit remains. ===2018=== With many Portuguese players abandoning QuakeWorld, from around 2007-2009 forward, the community slowly died.
In 2018 [[hammer]] and [[mushi]] brought the community back together on Discord.
Portuguese QuakeWorld community is together once again. ===2020 - 2024=== Our community is growing!
[https://discord.gg/EN6VP3e Join our discord]
With new Portuguese servers, created by [[ved]], and pings within the 12ms to 25ms, the Portuguese community get together a few days every week at late evenings for fun and games. ===2025 - 2026=== [[Ake Vader]] ran a server in Lisbon, to create a "bridge" to Fortaleza (Brazil). Pings of 77ms were possible, but usually 90-100ms. ===LANS=== '''Continental Portugal''' There were several [[LAN|LANs]].
One of the biggest was in Lisbon (organized by [[Ripper]]), with many players especially from the TF community.
Last LAN was in the year [[2001]]. The best LAN was at ''Hectic's place'' (200 km north of Lisbon).
In these LANs we played mostly [[CTF]] and a bit of [[DM]].
What was amazing about this was the spirit between the players.
The bounds created between these persons are Quake itself.
That's what makes Quake unique. Besides playing all night until Sunday's noon, we often went out for drinks, dinners and fun. I'm sure everyone who attended these LANs today have a feeling of nostalgia.
About the LAN itself, well, it was CTF all the way as i said.
There were 2 rooms (20-30 ppl in a garage), one for red team, the other for blue.
Ppl shouting at each other was a constant, the flag was the most important :) "VAI BUSCAR!!" was yelled when he/she captured.
The ones who didn't played CTF before became addicted. ''QW CTF is the best mod/game of all time'' (c) [[Trouble]] '''Madeira Island''' Many LANS happened in Madeira between 1997 and 2002.
[[ztranger]] organized quite a few at his school, Liceu Jaime Moniz.
We cannot forget that every day people used to get together at "Minha empresa" at "Oudinot Shopping" playing hours and hours at that Cyber place being charged by the hour.
[[hammer]] hosted one at his place but mostly were at [[nitemare]] home garage.
Between QuakeWorld, smoking and drinking , bonds were being reinforced and nowadays some members always get together at least once a year for a dinner, good times and more smoking and drinking :D
Last gathering was in December 2019 when [[mushi]] flew over for a unforgettable Christmas dinner.
